latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Irresistible Offer Builder skill.

- Guides small business owners through constructing a complete, compelling offer using an 8-element checklist (Value, Language, Reason Why, Value Stack, Upsells, Payment Plan, Outrageous Guarantee, Scarcity).
- Includes diagnostic questions to select the right product or service to feature.
- Designed to replace generic discount-based offers with differentiated, high-conversion alternatives.
- Produces a ready-to-use offer.md document for use in ads, landing pages, and sales conversations.
- Focuses on escaping commodity pricing and building offers tailored to a defined target market.
